explanation: Daphne du Maurier never gives her narrator a first name. She is simply the second Mrs de Winter, overshadowed by Rebecca, her husband's first wife.

claims.text: Daphne du Maurier's Rebecca (1938) begins 'Last night I dreamt I went to Manderley again.'
Jane Eyre, Jamaica Inn and Wuthering Heights do not begin with that sentence.
The narrator of Rebecca is never given a first name.
The narrator is the second wife of Maxim de Winter, and Rebecca was his first wife.
